title: Crawl Testing Scenarios (CRUD, DnD, Persistence)
description: Author and pass the crawl/testing scenarios from .aidd/testing-scenarios.md covering board/column/card CRUD, drag-and-drop, filtering, and reload persistence, integrated into the smoke:qc gate.
spec:
1. Scenario: create a board, add To Do/Doing/Done, add cards to To Do, drag one to Doing, reload, confirm all survived
2. Scenario: create several boards, rename one, switch active board, delete a board, confirm remaining boards/cards untouched
3. Scenario: add a column, rename it, reorder it, reload, confirm name+order persisted
4. Scenario: attempt to delete a non-empty column and confirm the defined rule is followed
5. Scenario: add a card with title/description/labels, edit each field, reload, confirm updates stuck
6. Scenario: reorder two cards within a column, reload, confirm order persisted
7. Scenario: move a card across columns, confirm source/target updates and reload persistence
8. Scenario: delete a card, confirm removed from cardOrder and absent after reload
9. Scenario: filter/search by text and label, confirm only matches visible until cleared
10. Scenario: corrupt/clear localStorage, reload, confirm clean default board (no crash)
11. Wire the scenarios into `bun run smoke:qc` (or a documented crawl step) so acceptance is verifiable
12. Verify all scenarios pass and the gate exits 0
